Name: AllPurposeTablet
Author: MoYuCSC
Description:
AllPurpose Tablet
A full-featured tablet computer for Stardew Valley — a rope charm dangles on screen, pull it down to summon the tablet. A dozen-plus apps cover farming, business, social life and daily management, with AI that brings the townsfolk to life.
[heading]The device[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Screen charm[/b]: pull the charm hanging on screen to open the tablet; charm style and position are customizable[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Hotkey[/b]: press [b]Ctrl+H[/b] to open the tablet; the key and the Ctrl requirement can both be changed in the mod config menu[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Home screen & wallpapers[/b]: arrange icons freely, switch wallpapers, or drop in your own images[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]App store[/b]: manage installed apps; third-party mods can register their own[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]File manager[/b]: browse the music and wallpaper files in the mod folder, apply a wallpaper or play a track[/*]
[/list][heading]Business[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Tasks & commissions[/b]: a daily board of AI-written jobs; one player per task, deadlines, and rewards of gold, friendship and a gift fitting each giver's trade[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Hire help[/b]: pay villagers to water crops, harvest, pet animals or mine for you[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Online shop[/b]: order from home with next-day delivery; browse by category, search, and hover for item details[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]E-commerce orders[/b]: a fresh batch of high-value orders every month for crops and artisan goods[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Stock market[/b]: several stocks, each with its own trend — buy low, sell high[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Remote warehouse[/b]: browse and organize every chest, with bulk take, sell and gifting[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Farm stats[/b]: income, expenses and business performance at a glance[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Remote building[/b]: hire Robin to build and upgrade without the trip[/*]
[/list][heading]Social & AI[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Social feed[/b]: post text and images, like, comment and reply, and @-mention people; typing @ opens a contact picker, mentions are highlighted and deleted as one block[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Messages[/b]: chat with villagers and multiplayer friends, stickers included, unread badges on avatars[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]AI villagers[/b]: conversations with memory, replies shaped by your relationship; they message you first, post and comment on the feed, and answer when mentioned[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Relationships[/b]: affection interactions that scale with relationship level, dates, and help around the farm[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Reminders[/b]: birthday and festival banners, tomorrow's weather, and gift parcels delivered to your mailbox[/*]
[/list][heading]Entertainment[/heading]
[list]
[*]Music player, gomoku, chess, alarm clock[/*]
[*]Music file naming convention: SongName_Artist
Album cover image filename: corresponding song name[/*]
[/list][heading]Multiplayer[/heading]
[list]
[*]Exclusive task claiming, per-player stock holdings, e-commerce and social content synced across the farm, plus direct messaging between players[/*]
[/list][heading]Developer API[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Custom apps[/b]: other mods can register their own apps (icon, name, description, open/close and draw callbacks) — they appear on the home screen and in the app store[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Tablet control[/b]: query whether the tablet is open, and open or close it programmatically[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Social API[/b]: post to the feed and to comments, reply to comments, like, read the timeline, and remove posts or comments[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Content policies[/b]: gate what players are about to publish — block or rewrite it, with a reason shown to the player[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Image registry[/b]: register custom images for posts (persistent texture / lazy provider / game asset name)[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Tasks & orders[/b]: add, query, accept, complete and remove commissions, and add, query, deliver or remove e-commerce orders[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Item eligibility[/b]: check whether an item is valid for commissions and orders[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]API and mod version fields for compatibility checks[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Note[/b]: The music and wallpaper assets bundled with the mod are demos only — please delete or replace them with your own files.


AllPurpose Tablet · 全能平板
把一台多功能平板电脑装进星露谷：屏幕上垂着一枚绳索挂件，按住往下一拉就能唤出平板。十余款应用覆盖农场经营、生意买卖、社交娱乐与日常管理，并接入 AI 让镇民真正"活"起来。
[heading]设备[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]屏幕挂饰[/b]：未开平板时挂件悬在屏幕边上，下拉即开；挂件样式与位置可自定义[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]快捷键[/b]：默认 [b]Ctrl+H[/b] 打开平板；按键与"是否需要按住 Ctrl"都能在模组配置菜单里修改[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]桌面与壁纸[/b]：图标自由摆放，壁纸随时更换，也支持放入自己的图片[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]应用商城[/b]：管理已装应用；第三方模组可注册自己的应用[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]文件管理器[/b]：浏览模组目录里的音乐与壁纸文件，一键应用壁纸、播放音乐[/*]
[/list][heading]经营[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]任务与委托[/b]：每日上架委托，内容由 AI 生成；接取独占、有交付期限，报酬含金币、好感与契合委托人身份的礼物[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]委托他人[/b]：花金币请镇民帮你浇水、收获、抚摸动物、下矿[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]网购平台[/b]：在家下单次日送达，分类浏览、搜索、悬停查看物品详情[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]电商订单[/b]：每月一批大额订单，把作物与工匠品卖个好价钱[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]股票行情[/b]：多支股票各有走势，低买高卖赚差价[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]线上仓库[/b]：远程查看整理所有箱子，批量取出、出售或赠送镇民[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]农场统计[/b]：收支与经营数据一目了然[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]远程建造[/b]：委托罗宾建造升级建筑，不必跑腿[/*]
[/list][heading]社交与 AI[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]社交平台[/b]：发图文动态、点赞、评论与回复、@ 提及；打 @ 弹出联系人选择，提及文字高亮、退格整块删除[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]短信[/b]：与镇民和联机好友聊天，支持表情包，头像带未读红点[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]AI 镇民[/b]：对话有记忆、依关系与好感回应；会主动给你发消息、在社交平台发帖评论、被你 @ 时回你[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]关系互动[/b]：随关系档位变化的亲昵互动、赴约约会、帮忙农活[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]提醒[/b]：生日与节日横幅、明日天气播报、镇民送礼包裹投递[/*]
[/list][heading]娱乐[/heading]
[list]
[*]音乐播放器、五子棋、国际象棋、闹钟
1. 音乐文件的命名规则：歌曲名_作者 
2. 音乐专辑封面图的文件名：相应歌曲名[/*]
[/list][heading]联机[/heading]
[list]
[*]委托独占接取、股票按玩家记账、电商与社交内容全端同步；玩家之间可直接互发短信[/*]
[/list][heading]开发者接口[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]自制应用[/b]：其他模组可注册自己的应用（图标、名称、介绍、打开/关闭与绘制回调），自动出现在桌面与应用商城[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]平板控制[/b]：查询平板是否打开，也可以程序方式开/关平板[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]社交接口[/b]：代发动态与评论、回复评论、点赞、读取时间线、删除帖子与评论[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]内容策略[/b]：对玩家即将发布的内容过闸——可拦截或改写（拒绝时给出理由提示）[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]图片仓库[/b]：注册自定义图片供动态使用（常驻贴图 / 懒加载回调 / 游戏资源名三种方式）[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]任务与订单[/b]：以程序方式新增、查询、接取、完成、下架委托；新增、查询、交付、移除电商订单[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]物品资格查询[/b]：判断某物品是否属于合规的委托/订单物品[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]提供接口版本号与模组版本号，便于兼容判断[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]附注[/b]：模组内置的音乐与壁纸素材仅作功能示范，请及时删除或替换为你自己的文件。
